description: Norms the Neko legal engine holds, in order of obligations for tokenization. match_title must appear near the top of the source or the ingest is refused. scij_nrm is the SCIJ norm id (nValor2, sinalevi param1) and scij_version the version id when known (null = take the current version). Non-Costa Rican norms have no scij_nrm and are ingested from a saved file with --file and --url.
